description: Gather information about Application Load Balancers in AWS.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: include_attributes
parameters.description: Whether or not to include load balancer attributes in the response. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: include_listener_rules
parameters.description: Whether or not to include load balancer listener rules in the response. Implies include_listeners=true Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: include_listeners
parameters.description: Whether or not to include load balancer listeners in the response. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: load_balancer_arns
parameters.description: The Amazon Resource Names (ARN) of the load balancers. You can specify up to 20 load balancers in a single call.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: The names of the load balancers.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

- name: Gather information about all ALBs
  amazon.aws.elb_application_lb_info:

# Equivalent to aws elbv2 describe-load-balancers
- name: Gather minimal information about all ALBs
  amazon.aws.elb_application_lb_info:
    include_attributes: false
    include_listeners: false
    include_listener_rules: false

- name: Gather information about a particular ALB given its ARN
  amazon.aws.elb_application_lb_info:
    load_balancer_arns:
      - "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-southeast-2:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/my-alb/aabbccddeeff"

- name: Gather information about ALBs named 'alb1' and 'alb2'
  amazon.aws.elb_application_lb_info:
    names:
      - alb1
      - alb2

- name: Gather information about specific ALB
  amazon.aws.elb_application_lb_info:
    names: "alb-name"
    region: "aws-region"
  register: alb_info
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: alb_info

return_values.name: load_balancers
return_values.description: A list of load balancers. Returned: always

return_values.name: access_logs_s3_bucket
return_values.description: The name of the S3 bucket for the access logs. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "mys3bucket"

return_values.name: access_logs_s3_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether access logs stored in Amazon S3 are enabled. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "true"

return_values.name: access_logs_s3_prefix
return_values.description: The prefix for the location in the S3 bucket. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "my/logs"

return_values.name: availability_zones
return_values.description: The Availability Zones for the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: [{"load_balancer_addresses": [], "subnet_id": "subnet-aabbccddff", "zone_name": "ap-southeast-2a"}]

return_values.name: load_balancer_addresses
return_values.description: Information about static IP addresses for a load balancer. Returned: success

return_values.name: allocation_id
return_values.description: The allocation ID of the Elastic IP address for an internal-facing load balancer. Returned: success

return_values.name: ip_address
return_values.description: The static IP address. Returned: success

return_values.name: ipv6_address
return_values.description: The IPv6 address. Returned: success

return_values.name: private_ipv4_address
return_values.description: The private IPv4 address for an internal load balancer. Returned: success

return_values.name: subnet_id
return_values.description: The ID of the subnet. Returned: success

return_values.name: zone_name
return_values.description: The name of the Availability Zone. Returned: success

return_values.name: canonical_hosted_zone_id
return_values.description: The ID of the Amazon Route 53 hosted zone associated with the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "ABCDEF12345678"

return_values.name: created_time
return_values.description: The date and time the load balancer was created. Returned: success Sample: "2015-02-12T02:14:02+00:00"

return_values.name: deletion_protection_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: true

return_values.name: dns_name
return_values.description: The public DNS name of the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "internal-my-alb-123456789.ap-southeast-2.elb.amazonaws.com"

return_values.name: idle_timeout_timeout_seconds
return_values.description: The idle timeout value, in seconds. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: 60

return_values.name: ip_address_type
return_values.description: The type of IP addresses used by the subnets for the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "ipv4"

return_values.name: listeners
return_values.description: Information about the listeners. Returned: when include_listeners=true or include_listener_rules=true

return_values.name: certificates
return_values.description: The SSL server certificate. Returned: success

return_values.name: certificate_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the certificate. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:123456789012:certificate/28d2f3d9-cb2f-4033-a9aa-e75e704125a2"

return_values.name: default_actions
return_values.description: The default actions for the listener. Returned: success Sample: "[{'forward_config': {'target_group_stickiness_config': {'enabled': False}, 'target_groups': [{'target_group_arn': 'arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:targetgroup/alb-test/bf43c68602c51c02', 'weight': 1}]}, 'target_group_arn': 'arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:targetgroup/alb-test/bf43c68602c51c02', 'type': 'forward'}]"

return_values.name: forward_config
return_values.description: Information for creating an action that distributes requests among one or more target groups. Returned: success

return_values.name: target_group_stickiness_config
return_values.description: The target group stickiness for the rule. Returned: success

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether target group stickiness is enabled. Returned: success

return_values.name: target_groups
return_values.description: The target groups. Returned: success

return_values.name: weight
return_values.description: The weight. Returned: success

return_values.name: target_group_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the target group. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The type of action. Returned: success

return_values.name: listener_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the listener. Returned: success Sample: ""

return_values.name: load_balancer_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: ""

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: The port on which the load balancer is listening. Returned: success Sample: 80

return_values.name: protocol
return_values.description: The protocol for connections from clients to the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "HTTPS"

return_values.name: rules
return_values.description: List of listener rules. Returned: when include_listener_rules=true

return_values.name: actions
return_values.description: The actions. Returned: success Sample: [{"forward_config": {"target_group_stickiness_config": {"enabled": false}, "target_groups": [{"target_group_arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:targetgroup/alb-test/09ba111f8079fb83", "weight": 1}]}, "target_group_arn": "arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:targetgroup/alb-test/09ba111f8079fb83", "type": "forward"}]

return_values.name: conditions
return_values.description: The conditions. Returned: success Sample: []

return_values.name: is_default
return_values.description: Indicates whether this is the default rule. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: The priority. Returned: success Sample: "default"

return_values.name: rule_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the rule. Returned: success Sample: ""

return_values.name: ssl_policy
return_values.description: The security policy that defines which ciphers and protocols are supported. Returned: success Sample: "ELBSecurityPolicy-2016-08"

return_values.name: load_balancer_name
return_values.description: The name of the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "my-alb"

return_values.name: load_balancing_cross_zone_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether or not cross-zone load balancing is enabled. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "true"

return_values.name: routing_http2_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "true"

return_values.name: routing_http_desync_mitigation_mode
return_values.description: Determines how the load balancer handles requests that might pose a security risk to an application. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "defensive"

return_values.name: routing_http_drop_invalid_header_fields_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether HTTP headers with invalid header fields are removed by the load balancer (true) or routed to targets (false). Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "false"

return_values.name: routing_http_x_amzn_tls_version_and_cipher_suite_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether the two headers are added to the client request before sending it to the target. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "false"

return_values.name: routing_http_xff_client_port_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether the X-Forwarded-For header should preserve the source port that the client used to connect to the load balancer. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "false"

return_values.name: scheme
return_values.description: Internet-facing or internal load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "internal"

return_values.name: security_groups
return_values.description: The IDs of the security groups for the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: ["sg-0011223344"]

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: The state of the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: {"code": "active"}

return_values.name: code
return_values.description: The state code. Returned: success

return_values.name: reason
return_values.description: A description of the state. Returned: when available

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: The tags attached to the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: {"Tag": "Example"}

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: The ID of the VPC for the load balancer. Returned: success Sample: "vpc-0011223344"

return_values.name: waf_fail_open_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether to allow a AWS WAF-enabled load balancer to route requests to targets if it is unable to forward the request to AWS WAF. Returned: when include_attributes=true Sample: "false"
